overview: Address price, timing, and trust objections using proven frameworks. Close confidently while maintaining relationships.
learningObjectives: Identify and address common closing objections

sections.title: Price Objections
sections.content: Acknowledge cost concern; position insurance coverage + warranty value; total cost of ownership.

sections.title: Decision‑Maker Objections
sections.content: Clarify what needs discussion; offer to explain to both parties; provide materials.

sections.title: Timing Objections
sections.content: Explain claim windows and damage progression; you handle paperwork; flexible scheduling.

sections.title: Trust/Company Objections
sections.content: Local credibility, values, references; why Roof‑ER exists — integrity, quality, simplicity.

sections.title: Advanced Techniques
sections.content: Feel‑Felt‑Found; Assumptive Close; Alternative Choice; creating appropriate urgency.

quiz.question: Describe Feel‑Felt‑Found and when to use it.
quiz.correctAnswer: Acknowledge feeling, relate with others who felt same, share what they found—use during objections to build rapport.
